Wastewater Treatment Division, King County (Wash.).. This datalayer contains points representing King County, Washington Wastewater Treatment Division facilities, including manholes, pump stations, regulator stations, and treatment plants. It covers the King County Wastewater Service Area, which includes also a portion of southern Snohomish County. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011.
